newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KARLSRUHE SQUEEZE PAST 1860 TO EARN UEFA SPOT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KARLSRUHE SQUEEZE PAST 1860 TO EARN UEFA SPOT.

text.p: A 1-1 draw with Freiburg on Saturday's final day of the Bundesliga season earned Karlsruhe sixth spot in the table -- the last remaining place guaranteeing European soccer next season.
A first-half goal from German international Michael Tarnat, in his last game from the club, gave Karlsruhe a share of the points and allowed them to squeeze past 1860 Munich on goal difference.
1860 squandered the chance to secure the all-important sixth spot by going down 3-0 away to Werder Bremen.
Bayern Munich, who secured the championship by beating Stuttgart last weekend, drew 2-2 with Borussia Moenchengladbach.
